h1: Orbis Hello — Lifestyle About Page Design
tagline: About page reference built on deep blue #13142D and bright lime #6FFF00, set in Anton and measured against type from 14px to 68px.
summary: About page reference for a lifestyle brand — React and Tailwind CSS, Anton, a 640x470 frame and a stats row.
about: Orbis Hello was captured at 640x470 and kept as a specification rather than as a gallery image. The palette is deep blue #13142D underneath, white #EFF4FF for the type and bright lime #6FFF00 carrying the accents, set in Anton. The build is React and Tailwind CSS; every measurement in it is written down, which is what makes it reusable. It is most useful when the Lifestyle about page has to survive a copy change without a redesign.

layout.title: Nothing here is inherited
layout.body: Sizes are quoted rather than inherited: type from 14px to 68px and 20px spacing steps. Swap the face or the copy and those relationships still hold. The frame proportions are recorded with the sizes, so a rebuild gets the aspect right as well.

layout.title: Proof above the fold
layout.body: Statistics are handled as typography: figures at the display size, labels at the smallest step in the brief, all of it on #6FFF00 or the ink colour rather than a coloured card. The figures carry the #6FFF00 accent while everything around them stays on the ink colour.

layout.title: The brief names the steps
layout.body: Spacing is quoted the same way (type from 14px to 68px and 20px spacing steps), not as a scale that grows on its own.

layout.title: A stat strip, not a table
layout.body: A row of stats sits above the fold, set in Anton at the top of the scale, with #6FFF00 left for the figures that carry a claim.

motion.title: Feedback on the controls
motion.body: Interaction is local to each control here (hover states on the buttons and links rather than on every card), so nothing on the page moves as a side effect. The interactive states do not move layout, so nothing jumps under the pointer. Do not animate layout on hover.

motion.title: Motion that stays out of the way
motion.body: This one is delivered as a still composition at 640x470, so the hierarchy has to work without motion, and it does. The composition holds still, so the hierarchy has to carry the page and it does.

notes: The accent is spent on bright lime #6FFF00 and the rest of the composition holds deep blue #13142D.

Accent and ground are both named (bright lime #6FFF00 on deep blue #13142D), so a brand swap moves one value.

editorial.title: What this about page gets right
editorial.body: The reason this works for a lifestyle brand is that it never asks the reader to assemble the message. Layout, type and colour are decided (deep blue #13142D and bright lime #6FFF00, set in Anton), so the first screen reads as a finished argument rather than a pile of parts. Orbis Hello states the offer once and lets the composition repeat it rather than adding a second claim.

editorial.title: What moves in Orbis Hello
editorial.body: Count the animated elements and the list is short: hover and press states. Nothing animates for its own sake in this about page.

editorial.title: How the about page reflows
editorial.body: The cost of a fluid scale is less control over exact sizes. What you get is a display line that stays proportionate, which is why a clamp between 14px and 68px is in the brief. The reflow keeps the action reachable at every width.

faq.question: What does the brief behind Orbis Hello actually contain?
faq.answer: The full prompt behind the page, describing the layout, the palette, the typography and the transitions, plus a one-click handoff into Studio with the brief already staged. The prompt itself is not printed here; copy it or send it to Studio. The reference was captured at 640x470.

faq.question: How much of Orbis Hello depends on React and Tailwind CSS?
faq.answer: Orbis Hello was built in React and Tailwind CSS, and the entry says so for provenance. The brief describes positions, sizes and timings, so it rebuilds in any framework that can set type and place elements.

faq.question: What are the colours in Orbis Hello?
faq.answer: The accent is bright lime #6FFF00 and it appears on the elements you are meant to press. Everything else stays on deep blue #13142D, so the emphasis never has to compete with the layout.
